I am evaluating p4's counter-offer. They want $210 for Oriental Avenue, but it costs only $100 to buy. That is a 110% premium. I own Baltic Avenue, and p1 owns Connecticut Avenue in the same light blue set.

Oriental does not complete a set for me. It would only block p1 from the light blue monopoly. Vermont is still unowned. Cash is too valuable early for this premium.

Rejecting the offer is the cleanest choice. Meeting in the middle around $175 would still be overpaying.

Rejecting the offer would end the trade. p1 might then acquire Oriental for a better price since it completes their light blue set. I will either reject or counter around $170.
